name: The Rockslide Crossing
setup: A slab of the granite shoulder has let go above the bridge path — a live rockslide field between you and the far bank, still ticking and settling.
stakes: Each slip costs blood, breath, or daylight — but the slide can be beaten a stage at a time.

party.ifYouBringPeople: ⚑ A LIVE SLIDE IS EASIER WITH HANDS AND WORSE WITH BODIES. More people can belay, spot and haul — ⚠️ and more people are more weight on ground that is still ticking. ⛔ The field does not care which of you it takes.
party.whatItAsksOfAParty: ⛔ Order and spacing. ⚑ A party that crosses together crosses once; a party that crosses as three people crosses three times.
party.foldNote: ⚑ Folded MOVE and PROTECT both pay here, which is rare — ⚠️ one gets you across, one gets you back.

_partyClauseWhy: ⛔ THE PARTY CLAUSE — R36/R36a, authored 2026-09-05. Every encounter in the corpus was written when a fight was ONE PERSON AGAINST ONE OPPONENT. ⚑ R36 makes a party member fight from their own sheet; R36a caps three acting fully and folds the rest. ⚠️ THE CLAUSE IS ADDITIVE — no prose changed. It is what a GM reads when more than one person is present.
